name: Spun
summary: A street-food stall that's joyful but well made: on white, the stall in action fills the right half (the iron opening, the pour, the floss), and one short line in very heavy Gabarito runs into the photograph. Under it, the next stop with a live countdown, and the week's stops as a line of tickets that crosses into the photo. Then today's board (prices in the waffle's crust colour, allergen codes, sold out struck through, save it as a picture), a drop, TikTok, and party bookings lower down. Raspberry for the accent; Labrada for reading. For bubble-waffle, candy-floss, churro, pancake, bubble-tea and loaded-fries stalls.
